181	    def confirm_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
182	        """Confirm a pending tip block.
183	
184	        Only a pending chain tip whose parent is confirmed can be confirmed.
185	        Confirming an already-confirmed block is idempotent (200); every
186	        other case — unknown or malformed height, non-tip pending block —
187	        returns 409.
188	        """
189	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
190	        with self.store.lock:
191	            if height_int is None:
192	                return 409, {"error": "block cannot be confirmed"}
193	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
194	            if block is None:
195	                return 409, {"error": "block cannot be confirmed"}
196	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED:
197	                # Idempotent re-confirm.
198	                return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": STATUS_CONFIRMED}
199	            if block is not self.store.tip():
200	                return 409, {"error": "only the chain tip can be confirmed"}
201	            parent = self.store.chain[-2] if len(self.store.chain) >= 2 else None
202	            if parent is None or parent.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
203	                return 409, {"error": "previous block is not confirmed"}
204	            block.status = STATUS_CONFIRMED
205	            try:
206	                self.store.save()
207	            except BaseException:
208	                block.status = STATUS_PENDING
209	                raise
210	            return 200, {"height": block.height, "status": STATUS_CONFIRMED}
211	
212	    def rollback_block(self, height: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
213	        """Roll back a pending tip block: delete it and restore its transactions.
214	
215	        Unknown or malformed heights (including an already-rolled-back
216	        height) return 404; a confirmed block or a non-tip block returns 409.
217	        """
218	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
219	        if height_int is None:
220	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
221	        with self.store.lock:
222	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
223	            if block is None:
224	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
225	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED:
226	                return 409, {"error": "confirmed block cannot be rolled back"}
227	            if block is not self.store.tip():
228	                return 409, {"error": "only the chain tip can be rolled back"}
229	            pending_before = set(self.store.pending)
230	            rolled_back = self.store.rollback_tip()
231	            try:
232	                self.store.save()
233	            except BaseException:
234	                # Restore the block and drop only the mempool entries we added.
235	                self.store.chain.append(rolled_back)
236	                for tx_id in list(self.store.pending):
237	                    if tx_id not in pending_before:
238	                        del self.store.pending[tx_id]
239	                raise
240	            return 200, {"height": rolled_back.height, "status": "rolled_back"}

242	    def get_proof(self, height: object, tx_id: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
243	        """Return a Merkle inclusion proof for tx_id at the given height.
244	
245	        Returns 404 for an unknown height, a malformed height/tx_id, or a
246	        transaction absent from that block. Proofs are only issued for
247	        confirmed blocks; a pending block returns 409.
248	        """
249	        height_int = _parse_height(height)
250	        if height_int is None:
251	            return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
252	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id):
253	            return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
254	        with self.store.lock:
255	            block = self.store.block_at(height_int)
256	            if block is None:
257	                return 404, {"error": "block not found"}
258	            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
259	                return 409, {"error": "block is pending confirmation"}
260	            tx_ids = [tx.tx_id for tx in block.transactions]
261	            try:
262	                index = tx_ids.index(tx_id)
263	            except ValueError:
264	                return 404, {"error": "transaction not found"}
265	            siblings = crypto.merkle_proof(tx_ids, index)
266	            return 200, {
267	                "height": block.height,
268	                "tx_id": tx_id,
269	                "index": index,
270	                "merkle_root": block.merkle_root,
271	                "block_hash": block.block_hash,
272	                "siblings": siblings,
273	            }

288	    def confirmed_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
289	        """Balance from confirmed blocks only."""
290	        entry = self.store.accounts.get(account)
291	        if entry is None:
292	            return self.initial_balance

295	    def reported_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
296	        """Confirmed balance minus spends sitting in the pending tip block.
297	
298	        Pending-block credits are not counted: unconfirmed income can still
299	        be rolled back, so it must not inflate the reported balance.
300	        """
301	        balance = self.confirmed_balance(account)
302	        tip = self.store.tip()
303	        if tip.status == STATUS_PENDING:
304	            for tx in tip.transactions:
305	                if tx.sender == account:
306	                    balance -= tx.amount
307	        return balance

309	    def available_balance(self, account: str) -> int:
310	        """Reported balance minus amounts already committed in the mempool.
311	
312	        Pending credits (mempool or unconfirmed block) are deliberately not
313	        counted, so a sequence of submissions cannot spend money that has not
314	        been confirmed yet.
315	        """
316	        balance = self.reported_balance(account)
317	        for tx in self.store.pending.values():
318	            if tx.sender == account:
319	                balance -= tx.amount
320	        return balance

324	    @staticmethod
325	    def _fork_summary(blocks: list) -> dict:
326	        """Public fork descriptor S: tip_hash, height, length, status."""
327	        tip = blocks[-1]
328	        return {
329	            "tip_hash": tip.block_hash,
330	            "height": tip.height,
331	            # The length counts every block including the genesis block.
332	            "length": len(blocks),
333	            "status": tip.status,
334	        }

336	    def _winning_fork(self) -> tuple[str, list]:
337	        """Pick the winner among the canonical chain and every candidate.
338	
339	        Longest chain wins; equal lengths are broken by the smallest tip hash
340	        (lexicographic hex order). Returns (tip_hash, block list).
341	        """
342	        contenders: list[tuple[str, list]] = [
343	            (self.store.tip_hash(), self.store.chain)
344	        ]
345	        contenders.extend(self.store.forks.items())
346	        contenders.sort(key=lambda item: (-len(item[1]), item[0]))
347	        return contenders[0]

349	    def submit_fork_candidate(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
350	        """POST /v1/forks/candidates — validate and store a candidate fork.
351	
352	        Returns 201 with the fork descriptor S. Malformed or invalid forks
353	        return 400; a fork already known (identical to the canonical tip or an
354	        existing candidate tip) returns 409.
355	        """
356	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
357	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object"}
358	        blocks_raw = payload.get("blocks")
359	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list):
360	            return 400, {"error": "missing field: blocks (must be a list)"}
361	        try:
362	            fork = self.store.validate_fork_blocks(blocks_raw)
363	        except ValueError as exc:
364	            return 400, {"error": str(exc)}
365	        summary = self._fork_summary(fork)
366	        # An exported fork (the five-field {tip_hash, height, length, status,
367	        # blocks} document) may be resubmitted verbatim; every supplied summary
368	        # field is re-verified against the recomputed descriptor.
369	        for field in ("tip_hash", "height", "length", "status"):
370	            if field in payload and payload[field] != summary[field]:
371	                return 400, {"error": f"summary field {field!r} does not match the blocks"}
372	        tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
373	        with self.store.lock:
374	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
375	            # A tip hash equal to any canonical block hash means the candidate
376	            # is exactly the canonical chain or a prefix of it (the block hash
377	            # binds height, parent and Merkle root), so it carries nothing new.
378	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in self.store.chain):
379	                return 409, {"error": "fork is identical to the canonical chain"}
380	            if tip_hash in self.store.forks:
381	                return 409, {"error": "candidate fork already exists", "tip_hash": tip_hash}
382	            self.store.forks[tip_hash] = fork
383	            try:
384	                self.store.save()
385	            except BaseException:
386	                self.store.forks.pop(tip_hash, None)
387	                raise
388	        return 201, self._fork_summary(fork)
389	
390	    def get_chain(self) -> tuple[int, dict]:
391	        """GET /v1/chain — canonical chain, candidates sorted by tip hash and
392	        the adoptable winner (a non-canonical chain that beats canonical).
393	        """
394	        with self.store.lock:
395	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
396	            canonical = self._fork_summary(self.store.chain)
397	            candidates = [
398	                self._fork_summary(self.store.forks[tip])
399	                for tip in sorted(self.store.forks)
400	            ]
401	            winner_tip, winner_chain = self._winning_fork()
402	            adoptable: list[dict] = []
403	            if winner_tip != self.store.tip_hash():
404	                adoptable.append(self._fork_summary(winner_chain))
405	            return 200, {
406	                "canonical": canonical,
407	                "candidates": candidates,
408	                "adoptable": adoptable,
409	            }

411	    def adopt_fork(self, tip_hash: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
412	        """POST /v1/forks/{tip_hash}/adopt — atomically switch to the winner.
413	
414	        Unknown tips return 404; adopting anything other than the current
415	        winning (longest / smallest-tip-hash) chain returns 409. Adoption
416	        replaces the canonical chain and mempool in one atomic write that
417	        advances the generation and rebuilds all indexes; transactions unique
418	        to the old chain's confirmed history return to the mempool, while
419	        pending-block transactions never enter it.
420	        """
421	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tip_hash):
422	            return 404, {"error": "unknown fork tip"}
423	        with self.store.lock:
424	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
425	            fork = self.store.forks.get(tip_hash)
426	            if fork is None:
427	                return 404, {"error": "unknown fork tip"}
428	            winner_tip, _ = self._winning_fork()
429	            if winner_tip != tip_hash:
430	                return 409, {"error": "only the winning fork can be adopted"}
431	            old_chain = self.store.chain
432	            old_pending = dict(self.store.pending)
433	            self.store.forks.pop(tip_hash)
434	            self.store.replace_chain(fork)
435	            try:
436	                self.store.save()
437	            except BaseException:
438	                # Restore the pre-adoption in-memory state on a failed write.
439	                self.store.chain = old_chain
440	                self.store.pending = old_pending
441	                self.store.forks[tip_hash] = fork
442	                self.store.rebuild_derived()
443	                raise
444	            return 200, self._fork_summary(fork)

446	    def export_fork(self, tip_hash: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
447	        """GET /v1/forks/{tip_hash}/export — full export of a candidate fork.
448	
449	        Only stored candidates are exportable: the canonical tip, an unknown
450	        tip and a malformed tip hash (not 64 lowercase hex chars) all return
451	        404. The response carries exactly five fields — the fork descriptor
452	        (tip_hash, height, length, status, all describing the tip block) plus
453	        the full block list including the genesis block, every transaction's
454	        signature and an optional pending tip — and can be resubmitted to
455	        POST /v1/forks/candidates verbatim.
456	        """
457	        if not crypto.is_hex64(tip_hash):
458	            return 404, {"error": "unknown fork tip"}
459	        with self.store.lock:
460	            fork = self.store.forks.get(tip_hash)
461	            if fork is None:
462	                return 404, {"error": "unknown fork tip"}
463	            body = self._fork_summary(fork)
464	            body["blocks"] = [block.to_dict() for block in fork]
465	            return 200, body

468	
469	    SYNC_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 50
470	    SYNC_MAX_LIMIT = 200
471	
472	    @staticmethod
473	    def _candidate_blocks(candidate: object) -> object:
474	        """Normalize a sync ``candidate`` to its raw blocks list.
475	
476	        The candidate follows the existing export format (the five-field
477	        ``{tip_hash, height, length, status, blocks}`` document); the
478	        ``{"blocks": [...]}`` wrapper and a bare block list are accepted too.
479	        """
480	        if isinstance(candidate, dict):
481	            return candidate.get("blocks")
482	        return candidate
483	
484	    @staticmethod
485	    def _candidate_fingerprint(blocks_raw: list) -> str:
486	        """Stable content fingerprint of a candidate's raw block list.
487	
488	        Used to decide whether a same-key retry carries the same candidate
489	        content. Key order and whitespace are normalized so two documents that
490	        serialize the same blocks identically compare equal.
491	        """
492	        return hashlib.sha256(
493	            json.dumps(blocks_raw, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
494	        ).hexdigest()
495	
496	    def _prune_expired_syncs(self) -> list[str]:
497	        """Sweep expired sync records and persist the sweep atomically.
498	
499	        A candidate received through a sync lives only while its record is
500	        unexpired; on expiry both the record and its still-stored candidate fork
501	        are dropped, together and in a single atomic save that advances the
502	        generation. Candidates submitted directly (no sync record) never
503	        expire, and an adopted tip is no longer in ``forks`` (it is on the
504	        canonical chain), so its expiring audit record leaves the chain
505	        untouched. If the write fails the pre-cleanup records and forks are
506	        restored so no success is ever reported for an un-persisted sweep.
507	        Caller must hold the store lock. Returns the pruned tip hashes.
508	        """
509	        expired_tips, removed = self.store.prune_syncs()
510	        if not removed:
511	            return expired_tips
512	        removed_forks: dict[str, list] = {}
513	        canonical_hashes = {block.block_hash for block in self.store.chain}
514	        # The same tip could theoretically be referenced by another live
515	        # record; only drop a fork nothing still points at.
516	        live_tips = {rec["tip_hash"] for rec in self.store.syncs.values()}
517	        for tip in expired_tips:
518	            if tip in canonical_hashes or tip in live_tips:
519	                continue
520	            fork = self.store.forks.pop(tip, None)
521	            if fork is not None:
522	                removed_forks[tip] = fork
523	        try:
524	            self.store.save()
525	        except BaseException:
526	            # Restore the pre-cleanup state: a failed write must neither leave
527	            # the records gone nor their candidates orphaned.
528	            self.store.restore_syncs(removed, removed_forks)
529	            raise
530	        return expired_tips

532	    def _tip_descriptor(self, tip_hash: str) -> dict | None:
533	        """Resolve (height/length/status) for a synced tip.
534	
535	        Looks the candidate up among stored forks first, then among canonical
536	        blocks, so audit rows remain available after the candidate is adopted.
537	        """
538	        fork = self.store.forks.get(tip_hash)
539	        if fork is not None:
540	            return self._fork_summary(fork)
541	        for block in self.store.chain:
542	            if block.block_hash == tip_hash:
543	                return {
544	                    "tip_hash": block.block_hash,
545	                    "height": block.height,
546	                    # Length counts every block including the genesis block.
547	                    "length": block.height + 1,
548	                    "status": block.status,
549	                }
550	        return None

552	    def submit_fork_sync(self, payload: object) -> tuple[int, dict]:
553	        """POST /v1/forks/sync — receive a candidate chain from another node.
554	
555	        The request carries ``source``, ``request_id``, ``expires_at`` (Unix
556	        seconds) and ``candidate`` (an export-format fork document). The
557	        candidate is re-validated exactly like a direct candidate submission
558	        (canonical genesis, consecutive heights and prev_hash linkage,
559	        recomputed block hashes and Merkle roots, tx_id and Ed25519 signatures,
560	        unique ascending tx_ids, endowment replay, pending-only-at-tip).
561	
562	        Returns 201 with ``{tip_hash, height, length, status, expires_at}``.
563	        An expired request returns 410; malformed fields or a failing chain
564	        validation return 400. A retry with the same source + request_id and
565	        identical content replays the original result as 200; the same key with
566	        different content, or a duplicate tip already known, returns 409.
567	        """
568	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
569	            return 400, {"error": "request body must be a JSON object"}
570	        for field in ("source", "request_id", "expires_at", "candidate"):
571	            if field not in payload:
572	                return 400, {"error": f"missing field: {field}"}
573	
574	        source = payload["source"]
575	        request_id = payload["request_id"]
576	        expires_at = payload["expires_at"]
577	        candidate = payload["candidate"]
578	
579	        if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
580	            return 400, {"error": "field 'source' must be a non-empty string"}
581	        if not isinstance(request_id, str) or not request_id:
582	            return 400, {"error": "field 'request_id' must be a non-empty string"}
583	        if isinstance(expires_at, bool) or not isinstance(expires_at, int):
584	            return 400, {"error": "field 'expires_at' must be a Unix-seconds integer"}
585	
586	        blocks_raw = self._candidate_blocks(candidate)
587	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list):
588	            return 400, {"error": "field 'candidate' must contain a 'blocks' list"}
589	
590	        with self.store.lock:
591	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
592	
593	            key = (source, request_id)
594	            existing = self.store.syncs.get(key)
595	
596	            # A new delivery whose deadline already passed is rejected before
597	            # the chain is examined. A retry on a still-live key skips this:
598	            # replaying a recorded request must stay idempotent even when the
599	            # client echoes an expires_at that has since elapsed.
600	            if existing is None and expires_at <= time.time():
601	                return 410, {"error": "sync request has expired"}
602	
603	            # Re-validate the whole candidate chain and recompute the tip
604	            # summary BEFORE any idempotency decision: a request whose supplied
605	            # tip_hash/height/length/status were tampered with must fail 400,
606	            # never be answered with the cached 200 for its source+request_id.
607	            try:
608	                fork = self.store.validate_fork_blocks(blocks_raw)
609	            except ValueError as exc:
610	                return 400, {"error": str(exc)}
611	            summary = self._fork_summary(fork)
612	            if isinstance(candidate, dict):
613	                for field in ("tip_hash", "height", "length", "status"):
614	                    if field in candidate and candidate[field] != summary[field]:
615	                        return 400, {
616	                            "error": f"candidate field {field!r} does not match the blocks"
617	                        }
618	            tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
619	            fingerprint = self._candidate_fingerprint(blocks_raw)
620	
621	            if existing is not None:
622	                # A retry on a live key is idempotent only when it carries the
623	                # identical candidate content; a changed body conflicts 409.
624	                if fingerprint != existing["fingerprint"]:
625	                    return 409, {
626	                        "error": "request_id already used with different content"
627	                    }
628	                descriptor = self._tip_descriptor(existing["tip_hash"]) or {
629	                    "tip_hash": existing["tip_hash"],
630	                    "height": None,
631	                    "length": None,
632	                    "status": None,
633	                }
634	                return 200, {
635	                    "tip_hash": descriptor["tip_hash"],
636	                    "height": descriptor.get("height"),
637	                    "length": descriptor.get("length"),
638	                    "status": descriptor.get("status"),
639	                    "expires_at": existing["expires_at"],
640	                }
641	
642	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in self.store.chain):
643	                return 409, {"error": "fork is identical to the canonical chain"}
644	            if tip_hash in self.store.forks:
645	                return 409, {
646	                    "error": "candidate fork already exists",
647	                    "tip_hash": tip_hash,
648	                }
649	
650	            self.store.forks[tip_hash] = fork
651	            self.store.syncs[key] = {
652	                "tip_hash": tip_hash,
653	                "expires_at": expires_at,
654	                "fingerprint": fingerprint,
655	            }
656	            try:
657	                self.store.save()
658	            except BaseException:
659	                # Roll back both the candidate and its metadata together so a
660	                # failed write never leaves one without the other.
661	                self.store.syncs.pop(key, None)
662	                self.store.forks.pop(tip_hash, None)
663	                raise
664	
665	            result = dict(summary)
666	            result["expires_at"] = expires_at
667	            return 201, result

669	    def list_fork_syncs(self, params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
670	        """GET /v1/forks/sync — audit listing of received sync candidates.
671	
672	        Filters: ``source`` (exact), ``min_height`` and ``max_height``.
673	        ``limit`` defaults to 50 and must be 1-200; ``cursor`` defaults to 0.
674	        Every numeric value must be a plain decimal without leading zeros; a
675	        malformed value returns 400. Rows are ordered by
676	        ``(height, tip_hash, source)``; ``cursor == total`` returns an empty
677	        page, ``cursor > total`` returns 400. Each item carries
678	        ``source, request_id, tip_hash, height, length, status, expires_at``.
679	        """
680	        source = params.get("source")
681	        if source is not None and (not isinstance(source, str) or not source):
682	            return 400, {"error": "source must be a non-empty string"}
683	
684	        min_height = None
685	        if params.get("min_height") is not None:
686	            min_height = _parse_decimal(params["min_height"])
687	            if min_height is None:
688	                return 400, {"error": "min_height must be a non-negative decimal"}
689	        max_height = None
690	        if params.get("max_height") is not None:
691	            max_height = _parse_decimal(params["max_height"])
692	            if max_height is None:
693	                return 400, {"error": "max_height must be a non-negative decimal"}
694	        if min_height is not None and max_height is not None and min_height > max_height:
695	            return 400, {"error": "min_height must not exceed max_height"}
696	
697	        limit = self.SYNC_DEFAULT_LIMIT
698	        if params.get("limit") is not None:
699	            parsed = _parse_decimal(params["limit"])
700	            if parsed is None or not 1 <= parsed <= self.SYNC_MAX_LIMIT:
701	                return 400, {"error": "limit must be a decimal between 1 and 200"}
702	            limit = parsed
703	        cursor = 0
704	        if params.get("cursor") is not None:
705	            parsed = _parse_decimal(params["cursor"])
706	            if parsed is None:
707	                return 400, {"error": "cursor must be a non-negative decimal"}
708	            cursor = parsed
709	
710	        with self.store.lock:
711	            self._prune_expired_syncs()
712	            rows: list[dict] = []
713	            for (rec_source, request_id), rec in self.store.syncs.items():
714	                if source is not None and rec_source != source:
715	                    continue
716	                descriptor = self._tip_descriptor(rec["tip_hash"])
717	                if descriptor is None:
718	                    continue
719	                if min_height is not None and descriptor["height"] < min_height:
720	                    continue
721	                if max_height is not None and descriptor["height"] > max_height:
722	                    continue
723	                rows.append(
724	                    {
725	                        "source": rec_source,
726	                        "request_id": request_id,
727	                        "tip_hash": descriptor["tip_hash"],
728	                        "height": descriptor["height"],
729	                        "length": descriptor["length"],
730	                        "status": descriptor["status"],
731	                        "expires_at": rec["expires_at"],
732	                    }
733	                )
734	
735	        rows.sort(key=lambda row: (row["height"], row["tip_hash"], row["source"]))
736	        total = len(rows)
737	        if cursor > total:
738	            return 400, {"error": "cursor is beyond the result set"}
739	        items = rows[cursor : cursor + limit]
740	        next_cursor = cursor + limit if cursor + limit < total else None
741	        return 200, {"items": items, "total": total, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

744	    # -- transaction index ----------------------------------------------------
745	
746	    INDEX_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 50
747	    INDEX_MAX_LIMIT = 200
748	
749	    def list_transactions(self, params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
750	        """GET /v1/index/transactions — paginated confirmed-chain tx index.
751	
752	        Pending-tip transactions are excluded. Filters (AND-combined):
753	        ``tx_id`` (64 lowercase hex), ``account`` (matches sender or
754	        recipient) and ``height``; ``limit`` (default 50, range 1-200) and
755	        ``cursor`` (default 0) paginate. Numeric filters must be plain
756	        decimals without leading zeros; any malformed value returns 400.
757	        Rows are ordered by (height, index, tx_id); ``index`` is the
758	        transaction's 0-based position inside its block, matching the Merkle
759	        proof index. A cursor beyond the filtered total returns 400, a cursor
760	        equal to it returns an empty page.
761	        """
762	        tx_id = params.get("tx_id")
763	        if tx_id is not None and not crypto.is_hex64(tx_id):
764	            return 400, {"error": "tx_id must be 64 lowercase hex characters"}
765	        account = params.get("account")
766	        if account is not None and (not isinstance(account, str) or not account):
767	            return 400, {"error": "account must be a non-empty string"}
768	
769	        height = None
770	        if params.get("height") is not None:
771	            height = _parse_decimal(params["height"])
772	            if height is None:
773	                return 400, {"error": "height must be a non-negative decimal"}
774	        limit = self.INDEX_DEFAULT_LIMIT
775	        if params.get("limit") is not None:
776	            parsed = _parse_decimal(params["limit"])
777	            if parsed is None or not 1 <= parsed <= self.INDEX_MAX_LIMIT:
778	                return 400, {"error": "limit must be a decimal between 1 and 200"}
779	            limit = parsed
780	        cursor = 0
781	        if params.get("cursor") is not None:
782	            parsed = _parse_decimal(params["cursor"])
783	            if parsed is None:
784	                return 400, {"error": "cursor must be a non-negative decimal"}
785	            cursor = parsed
786	
787	        with self.store.lock:
788	            rows: list[dict] = []
789	            for block in self.store.chain:
790	                if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
791	                    continue
792	                if height is not None and block.height != height:
793	                    continue
794	                for index, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
795	                    if tx_id is not None and tx.tx_id != tx_id:
796	                        continue
797	                    if account is not None and account not in (tx.sender, tx.recipient):
798	                        continue
799	                    rows.append(
800	                        {
801	                            "tx_id": tx.tx_id,
802	                            "height": block.height,
803	                            "block_hash": block.block_hash,
804	                            "index": index,
805	                            "from": tx.sender,
806	                            "to": tx.recipient,
807	                            "amount": tx.amount,
808	                        }
809	                    )
810	        # Chain order is already (height, index) ascending; the tx_id
811	        # tiebreaker is implied because ids are unique within a block.
812	        total = len(rows)
813	        if cursor > total:
814	            return 400, {"error": "cursor is beyond the result set"}
815	        items = rows[cursor : cursor + limit]
816	        next_cursor = cursor + limit if cursor + limit < total else None
817	        return 200, {"items": items, "total": total, "next_cursor": next_cursor}

1	"""Persistent storage: blockchain, pending set and derived indexes (JSON).
2	
3	The whole state is one JSON document written atomically: a uniquely named
4	``.ledger-*`` snapshot is fsynced in the same directory and then promoted over
5	the main file with ``os.replace`` (followed by a directory fsync). Every
6	successful write advances a monotonic ``generation`` recorded in the
7	snapshot. A crash can therefore only leave behind (a) the previous main file
8	or (b) a fully fsynced snapshot that never got renamed — never a torn file.
9	
10	On startup the main file and every sibling ``.ledger-*`` snapshot are treated
11	as recovery candidates. When no file exists at all, the unique genesis block
12	is created; otherwise each candidate is strictly validated (JSON, generation,
13	consecutive heights, prev_hash linkage, recomputed block hashes and Merkle
14	roots, per-transaction tx_id and Ed25519 signature, pending-only-at-tip and
15	mempool/chain de-duplication). The valid snapshot with the highest generation
16	wins and is promoted if it is still a temp file; same-generation content
17	conflicts, or a directory with no valid candidate, raise StateRecoveryError
18	with the offending path and reason — a fresh chain is never silently created.
19	
20	One atomic write persists everything: the chain (each block carries its
21	confirm/rollback ``status``), a small ``state`` summary, the mempool
22	(``pending``), candidate fork chains (``forks``, each a full block list
23	anchored at the canonical genesis and keyed by its tip hash), the
24	confirmed-transaction ``index`` and the confirmed ``accounts`` activity.
25	Derived data (index/accounts) is *rebuilt* from the chain on every load and
26	every save — pending blocks are excluded, so a restart never resurrects
27	unconfirmed transactions into balances. Persisted fork candidates are
28	re-validated on startup and invalid ones are dropped, while canonical-chain
29	invalidity remains fatal. A re-entrant lock serializes all updates, and a
30	class-wide recovery lock serializes startup scans against in-flight writes.
31	"""
32	from __future__ import annotations
33	
34	import json
35	import os
36	import tempfile
37	import threading
38	import time
39	
40	from .models import (
41	    STATUS_CONFIRMED,
42	    STATUS_PENDING,
43	    Block,
44	    Transaction,
45	    compute_block_hash,
46	)
47	from . import crypto
48	
49	# Previous hash of the genesis block.
50	GENESIS_PREV_HASH = "0" * 64
51	
52	# On-disk schema version, stored under "state" so future migrations are possible.
53	STATE_VERSION = 5
54	
55	# Prefix of durable snapshot temp files ("<state>.ledger-<...>") living next to
56	# the main state file. They double as crash-recovery candidates on startup.
57	SNAPSHOT_PREFIX = ".ledger-"
58	
59	
60	class StateRecoveryError(ValueError):
61	    """Raised when no usable on-disk state can be recovered on startup.
62	
63	    Carries the candidate ``path`` that failed and a human-readable ``reason``
64	    so callers can report (or catch) the failure explicitly. The exception is a
65	    ``ValueError`` subclass, so older callers expecting ``ValueError`` on a
66	    corrupt state file keep working.
67	    """
68	
69	    def __init__(self, path: str, reason: str) -> None:
70	        self.path = path
71	        self.reason = reason
72	        super().__init__(f"cannot recover ledger state from {path}: {reason}")
73	
74	
75	class LedgerStore:
76	    def __init__(self, path: str, initial_balance: int | None = None) -> None:
77	        self.path = path
78	        self.chain: list[Block] = []
79	        self.pending: dict[str, Transaction] = {}
80	        # Candidate fork chains keyed by tip block hash. Each value is the
81	        # fork's full block list (including the shared genesis block).
82	        self.forks: dict[str, list[Block]] = {}
83	        # Inter-node sync submissions keyed by (source, request_id). Each
84	        # record stores delivery metadata plus the tip hash of the synced
85	        # candidate chain (kept in ``forks``) and a content fingerprint used
86	        # for same-key retry/idempotency checks.
87	        self.syncs: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
88	        # Per-identity endowment used for candidate replay checks; recorded in
89	        # the snapshot so recovery validates against the same convention.
90	        self.initial_balance: int | None = initial_balance
91	        # Monotonic counter bumped on every successful atomic write. It is
92	        # persisted with each snapshot and lets startup pick the newest one.
93	        self.generation: int = 0
94	        # Derived, confirmed-only views; rebuilt by rebuild_derived().
95	        self.tx_index: dict[str, int] = {}
96	        self.accounts: dict[str, dict] = {}
97	        self._lock = threading.RLock()
98	        self.load()
99	
100	    @property
101	    def lock(self) -> threading.RLock:
102	        return self._lock
103	
104	    # Serializes startup scans/promotions between threads (or two store
105	    # instances on the same path) within one process. All later mutations take
106	    # the per-store re-entrant lock.
107	    _recovery_lock = threading.RLock()
108	
109	    def load(self) -> None:
110	        """Recover state from disk on startup.
111	
112	        The main file *and* every sibling ``.ledger-*`` snapshot are treated
113	        as recovery candidates. When none exist at all, the unique genesis
114	        block is created (the established first-start convention); otherwise
115	        every candidate is strictly validated and the valid snapshot with the
116	        highest generation wins. A winning temp snapshot is atomically
117	        promoted over the main file and every judged-older or residual
118	        candidate is removed. Same-generation snapshots with conflicting
119	        content, or a directory with no valid candidate, raise
120	        StateRecoveryError — a fresh chain is never silently created.
121	        """
122	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.path)) or "."
123	        with self._recovery_lock:
124	            candidates = self._discover_candidates(directory)
125	            if not candidates:
126	                os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
127	                self.chain = [self.create_genesis()]
128	                self.pending = {}
129	                self.forks = {}
130	                self.syncs = {}
131	                self.generation = 0
132	                self.rebuild_derived()
133	                self.save()
134	                return
135	
136	            valid: list[tuple] = []
137	            errors: list[StateRecoveryError] = []
138	            for candidate in candidates:
139	                try:
140	                    data = self._read_candidate(candidate)
141	                    parsed = self._parse_snapshot(candidate, data)
142	                except StateRecoveryError as exc:
143	                    errors.append(exc)
144	                    continue
145	                valid.append(
146	                    (
147	                        parsed[2],
148	                        candidate,
149	                        parsed[0],
150	                        parsed[1],
151	                        parsed[3],
152	                        parsed[4],
153	                        parsed[5],
154	                    )
155	                )
156	
157	            if not valid:
158	                details = "; ".join(f"{exc.path} ({exc.reason})" for exc in errors)
159	                raise StateRecoveryError(
160	                    directory, f"no valid snapshot candidate found: {details}"
161	                )
162	
163	            max_generation = max(item[0] for item in valid)
164	            top = [item for item in valid if item[0] == max_generation]
165	            reference = self._canonical_view(
166	                top[0][2], top[0][3], top[0][4], top[0][6]
167	            )
168	            for item in top[1:]:
169	                if (
170	                    self._canonical_view(item[2], item[3], item[4], item[6])
171	                    != reference
172	                ):
173	                    paths = " vs ".join(item[1] for item in top)
174	                    raise StateRecoveryError(
175	                        directory,
176	                        f"conflicting snapshots at generation {max_generation}: {paths}",
177	                    )
178	
179	            # Identical same-generation snapshots: keep the main file when it
180	            # is one of them, avoiding a pointless promotion cycle.
181	            main_abs = os.path.abspath(self.path)
182	            winner = top[0]
183	            for item in top:
184	                if os.path.abspath(item[1]) == main_abs:
185	                    winner = item
186	                    break
187	            (
188	                generation,
189	                winner_path,
190	                chain,
191	                pending,
192	                forks,
193	                winner_init_balance,
194	                syncs,
195	            ) = winner
196	
197	            if os.path.abspath(winner_path) != main_abs:
198	                # The newest durable state only ever made it to a temp
199	                # snapshot (a crash interrupted the promotion): promote it.
200	                os.replace(winner_path, self.path)
201	                self._fsync_dir(directory)
202	
203	            self.chain = chain
204	            self.pending = pending
205	            self.forks = forks
206	            self.syncs = syncs
207	            self.generation = generation
208	            # Prefer the endowment recorded by the writer; fall back to the
209	            # value this instance was constructed with, and finally to the
210	            # service default, so older snapshots without the field still
211	            # validate fork replays against the configured endowment.
212	            if winner_init_balance is not None:
213	                self.initial_balance = winner_init_balance
214	            self.rebuild_derived()
215	            self._cleanup_candidates(directory)
216	
217	    def _discover_candidates(self, directory: str) -> list[str]:
218	        """List the main file and sibling .ledger-* snapshots (if any)."""
219	        candidates: list[str] = []
220	        if os.path.exists(self.path):
221	            candidates.append(self.path)
222	        try:
223	            names = sorted(os.listdir(directory))
224	        except OSError:
225	            return candidates
226	        main_name = os.path.basename(self.path)
227	        for name in names:
228	            if name == main_name or not name.startswith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX):
229	                continue
230	            full = os.path.join(directory, name)
231	            if os.path.isfile(full):
232	                candidates.append(full)
233	        return candidates
234	
235	    @staticmethod
236	    def _canonical_view(
237	        chain: list[Block],
238	        pending: dict[str, Transaction],
239	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]],
240	        syncs: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] | None = None,
241	    ) -> str:
242	        """Order-independent canonical content hash for conflict detection."""
243	        sync_records = [
244	            {
245	                "source": key[0],
246	                "request_id": key[1],
247	                "tip_hash": rec["tip_hash"],
248	                "expires_at": rec["expires_at"],
249	                "fingerprint": rec["fingerprint"],
250	            }
251	            for key, rec in sorted((syncs or {}).items())
252	        ]
253	        return json.dumps(
254	            {
255	                "chain": [block.to_dict() for block in chain],
256	                "pending": [pending[tx_id].to_dict() for tx_id in sorted(pending)],
257	                "forks": [
258	                    [block.to_dict() for block in forks[tip]]
259	                    for tip in sorted(forks)
260	                ],
261	                "syncs": sync_records,
262	            },
263	            sort_keys=True,
264	            ensure_ascii=False,
265	        )
266	
267	    def _cleanup_candidates(self, directory: str) -> None:
268	        """Remove every residual .ledger-* snapshot next to the main file.
269	
270	        After recovery these are by definition unusable leftovers: older
271	        generations, an identical post-promotion residue, or a partially
272	        written (invalid) file. The promoted/main state is never touched.
273	        """
274	        main_name = os.path.basename(self.path)
275	        for name in list(os.listdir(directory)):
276	            if not name.startswith(SNAPSHOT_PREFIX) or name == main_name:
277	                continue
278	            full = os.path.join(directory, name)
279	            try:
280	                if os.path.isfile(full) or os.path.islink(full):
281	                    os.unlink(full)
282	            except OSError:
283	                pass
284	        self._fsync_dir(directory)
285	
286	    @staticmethod
287	    def _read_candidate(path: str) -> dict:
288	        """Read and JSON-decode one snapshot file.
289	
290	        Any I/O or JSON failure becomes a StateRecoveryError carrying the
291	        offending path, never a silent fall-back.
292	        """
293	        try:
294	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
295	                data = json.load(fh)
296	        except OSError as exc:
297	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, f"cannot read file: {exc}") from exc
298	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
299	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, f"invalid JSON: {exc}") from exc
300	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
301	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "snapshot root must be a JSON object")
302	        return data
303	
304	    def _parse_snapshot(
305	        self, path: str, data: dict
306	    ) -> tuple[
307	        list[Block],
308	        dict[str, Transaction],
309	        int,
310	        dict[str, list[Block]],
311	        int | None,
312	        dict[tuple[str, str], dict],
313	    ]:
314	        """Strictly validate one decoded snapshot.
315	
316	        Checks the persisted generation, consecutive heights, prev_hash
317	        linkage, recomputed block hashes, recomputed Merkle roots, every
318	        transaction's tx_id and Ed25519 signature, the pending-only-at-tip
319	        rule, and de-duplication between mempool and chain. Returns the parsed
320	        chain, mempool, generation, candidate forks and the recorded initial
321	        balance. Raises StateRecoveryError on the first defect, with ``path``
322	        identifying the candidate.
323	        """
324	        def fail(reason: str) -> None:
325	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, reason)
326	
327	        chain_raw = data.get("chain")
328	        if not isinstance(chain_raw, list) or not chain_raw:
329	            fail("snapshot must contain a non-empty chain")
330	
331	        state = data.get("state")
332	        # A pre-state-section snapshot is accepted: the chain itself is fully
333	        # self-verifying below. A present non-object section is corruption.
334	        if state is None:
335	            state = {}
336	        if not isinstance(state, dict):
337	            fail("invalid 'state' section: must be a JSON object")
338	        generation = state.get("generation", 0)
339	        # bool is an int subclass; reject it explicitly along with negatives.
340	        if isinstance(generation, bool) or not isinstance(generation, int) or generation < 0:
341	            fail("state.generation must be a non-negative integer")
342	        initial_balance = state.get("initial_balance")
343	        if initial_balance is not None and (
344	            isinstance(initial_balance, bool)
345	            or not isinstance(initial_balance, int)
346	            or initial_balance <= 0
347	        ):
348	            fail("state.initial_balance must be a positive integer")
349	
350	        chain: list[Block] = []
351	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
352	        for i, block_raw in enumerate(chain_raw):
353	            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
354	                fail(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
355	            try:
356	                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
357	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
358	                fail(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}")
359	            if block.height != i:
360	                fail(
361	                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height "
362	                    f"{block.height}"
363	                )
364	            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else chain[i - 1].block_hash
365	            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
366	                fail(f"block {block.height} has a mismatched prev_hash")
367	            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
368	                fail(f"block {block.height} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
369	            if i == 0 and (
370	                block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED or block.transactions
371	            ):
372	                fail("genesis block must be confirmed and carry no transactions")
373	            # Pending blocks may only sit at the chain tip.
374	            if i < len(chain_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
375	                fail(f"pending block {block.height} is not the chain tip")
376	
377	            # Validate every transaction: stored tx_id, recomputed tx_id and
378	            # the Ed25519 signature.
379	            tx_ids: list[str] = []
380	            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
381	            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
382	                fail(f"block {block.height} transactions must be a list")
383	            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
384	                self._validate_transaction(path, tx)
385	                stored_tx_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
386	                if stored_tx_id != tx.tx_id:
387	                    fail(
388	                        f"transaction in block {block.height} has a mismatched "
389	                        f"tx_id (stored {stored_tx_id!r}, recomputed {tx.tx_id})"
390	                    )
391	                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
392	                    fail(
393	                        f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in block "
394	                        f"{block.height}"
395	                    )
396	                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
397	                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
398	            # Blocks store transactions in ascending tx_id order.
399	            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
400	                fail(f"block {block.height} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
401	
402	            recomputed_merkle = crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids)
403	            if recomputed_merkle != block.merkle_root:
404	                fail(f"block {block.height} Merkle root mismatch")
405	            recomputed_hash = compute_block_hash(
406	                block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root
407	            )
408	            if recomputed_hash != block.block_hash:
409	                fail(f"block {block.height} block_hash mismatch")
410	            chain.append(block)
411	
412	        # Mempool: well-formed, no internal duplicates, never overlapping the
413	        # chain (neither confirmed nor pending-block transactions).
414	        pending: dict[str, Transaction] = {}
415	        pending_raw = data.get("pending", [])
416	        if not isinstance(pending_raw, list):
417	            fail("'pending' must be a list")
418	        for tx_raw in pending_raw:
419	            if not isinstance(tx_raw, dict):
420	                fail("pending entry is not a JSON object")
421	            try:
422	                tx = Transaction.from_dict(tx_raw)
423	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
424	                fail(f"pending transaction is malformed: {exc}")
425	            self._validate_transaction(path, tx)
426	            if tx_raw.get("tx_id") != tx.tx_id:
427	                fail(
428	                    f"pending transaction has a mismatched tx_id (stored "
429	                    f"{tx_raw.get('tx_id')!r}, recomputed {tx.tx_id})"
430	                )
431	            if tx.tx_id in pending:
432	                fail(f"duplicate pending transaction {tx.tx_id} in mempool")
433	            if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
434	                fail(
435	                    f"pending transaction {tx.tx_id} already exists in a block"
436	                )
437	            pending[tx.tx_id] = tx
438	
439	        # Cross-check the persisted tip summary against the chain tail.
440	        tip = chain[-1]
441	        if state.get("height") is not None and state["height"] != tip.height:
442	            fail("state.height does not match the chain tip")
443	        if state.get("tip_hash") is not None and state["tip_hash"] != tip.block_hash:
444	            fail("state.tip_hash does not match the chain tip")
445	        if (
446	            state.get("tip_status") is not None
447	            and state["tip_status"] != tip.status
448	        ):
449	            fail("state.tip_status does not match the chain tip")
450	
451	        forks = self._parse_persisted_forks(data.get("forks", []), chain)
452	        syncs, synced_tips = self._parse_persisted_syncs(
453	            data.get("syncs", []), forks, chain
454	        )
455	        # A fork brought in only by a sync record loses its right to exist once
456	        # that record is gone (expired/invalid on restart): without this, the
457	        # independently-persisted fork would resurrect as a never-expiring
458	        # candidate. Direct submissions carry no sync record and are untouched.
459	        live_tips = {rec["tip_hash"] for rec in syncs.values()}
460	        canonical_hashes = {block.block_hash for block in chain}
461	        for tip in synced_tips - live_tips - canonical_hashes:
462	            forks.pop(tip, None)
463	        return chain, pending, generation, forks, initial_balance, syncs
464	
465	    def _parse_persisted_syncs(
466	        self,
467	        syncs_raw: object,
468	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]],
469	        canonical_chain: list[Block],
470	    ) -> tuple[dict[tuple[str, str], dict], set[str]]:
471	        """Parse persisted sync records, dropping unusable ones on restart.
472	
473	        A record is kept only when it is structurally valid and has not yet
474	        expired. Its tip must reference either a surviving candidate fork or a
475	        block on the canonical chain (a synced candidate may have been adopted);
476	        records pointing at neither are stale orphans and are pruned. Invalid
477	        or expired records are silently dropped rather than failing recovery of
478	        the canonical chain. Also returns the set of every tip any sync record
479	        claims provenance for (including expired ones), so the caller can drop
480	        forks that only an expired sync kept alive.
481	        """
482	        if not isinstance(syncs_raw, list):
483	            return {}, set()
484	        now = time.time()
485	        canonical_hashes = {block.block_hash for block in canonical_chain}
486	        syncs: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
487	        synced_tips: set[str] = set()
488	        for rec_raw in syncs_raw:
489	            if not isinstance(rec_raw, dict):
490	                continue
491	            source = rec_raw.get("source")
492	            request_id = rec_raw.get("request_id")
493	            tip_hash = rec_raw.get("tip_hash")
494	            expires_at = rec_raw.get("expires_at")
495	            fingerprint = rec_raw.get("fingerprint")
496	            if not isinstance(source, str) or not source:
497	                continue
498	            if not isinstance(request_id, str) or not request_id:
499	                continue
500	            if not crypto.is_hex64(tip_hash):
501	                continue
502	            # Provenance is recorded even for expired records: it proves the
503	            # matching fork must not outlive the sync that delivered it.
504	            synced_tips.add(tip_hash)
505	            if (
506	                isinstance(expires_at, bool)
507	                or not isinstance(expires_at, int)
508	                or expires_at <= now
509	            ):
510	                continue
511	            if not isinstance(fingerprint, str) or not fingerprint:
512	                continue
513	            if tip_hash not in forks and tip_hash not in canonical_hashes:
514	                continue
515	            key = (source, request_id)
516	            if key in syncs:
517	                continue
518	            syncs[key] = {
519	                "tip_hash": tip_hash,
520	                "expires_at": expires_at,
521	                "fingerprint": fingerprint,
522	            }
523	        return syncs, synced_tips

525	    @staticmethod
526	    def _validate_transaction(path: str, tx: Transaction) -> None:
527	        """Recompute a transaction's id and check its Ed25519 signature."""
528	        if (
529	            not isinstance(tx.sender, str)
530	            or not isinstance(tx.recipient, str)
531	            or not tx.sender
532	            or not tx.recipient
533	        ):
534	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "transaction has invalid from/to fields")
535	        if (
536	            isinstance(tx.amount, bool)
537	            or not isinstance(tx.amount, int)
538	            or tx.amount <= 0
539	        ):
540	            raise StateRecoveryError(
541	                path, f"transaction {getattr(tx, 'sender', '?')} has non-positive amount"
542	            )
543	        if not isinstance(tx.signature, str) or not tx.signature:
544	            raise StateRecoveryError(path, "transaction is missing a signature")
545	        if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
546	            raise StateRecoveryError(
547	                path, f"transaction {tx.tx_id} has an invalid signature"
548	            )

550	    @staticmethod
551	    def create_genesis() -> Block:
552	        # The genesis block is born confirmed.
553	        return Block.create(
554	            height=0,
555	            prev_hash=GENESIS_PREV_HASH,
556	            transactions=[],
557	            status=STATUS_CONFIRMED,
558	        )

560	    def rebuild_derived(self) -> None:
561	        """Rebuild the confirmed-only transaction index and account activity.
562	
563	        Pending blocks are excluded: only confirmed blocks contribute to
564	        balances and to the tx_id -> height index.
565	        """
566	        self.tx_index = {}
567	        self.accounts = {}
568	        for block in self.chain:
569	            if block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED:
570	                continue
571	            for tx in block.transactions:
572	                self.tx_index[tx.tx_id] = block.height
573	                for account in (tx.sender, tx.recipient):
574	                    entry = self.accounts.setdefault(
575	                        account, {"sent": 0, "received": 0, "transactions": []}
576	                    )
577	                    entry["transactions"].append(tx.tx_id)
578	                self.accounts[tx.sender]["sent"] += tx.amount
579	                self.accounts[tx.recipient]["received"] += tx.amount
580	
581	    def save(self) -> None:
582	        """Atomically persist chain, state, pending set, index and accounts.
583	
584	        The new state is first written to a uniquely named ``.ledger-*``
585	        snapshot in the same directory and force-fsynced; only after that does
586	        an atomic ``os.replace`` promote it to the main file. A crash between
587	        the fsync and the promotion leaves the snapshot behind, where the
588	        startup scan finds it as a recovery candidate. The in-memory
589	        ``generation`` is advanced only after the promotion succeeds, so every
590	        *successful* atomic write corresponds to exactly one generation.
591	        """
592	        self.rebuild_derived()
593	        next_generation = self.generation + 1
594	        data = {
595	            "state": {
596	                "version": STATE_VERSION,
597	                "generation": next_generation,
598	                "height": self.chain[-1].height,
599	                "tip_hash": self.chain[-1].block_hash,
600	                "tip_status": self.chain[-1].status,
601	                "initial_balance": self.initial_balance,
602	            },
603	            "chain": [block.to_dict() for block in self.chain],
604	            "pending": [tx.to_dict() for tx in self.pending.values()],
605	            "index": dict(self.tx_index),
606	            "accounts": self.accounts,
607	        }
608	        # Only persist a forks section when candidates exist so a chain with
609	        # no forks keeps the canonical snapshot layout; loads default to [].
610	        if self.forks:
611	            data["forks"] = [
612	                [block.to_dict() for block in fork]
613	                for fork in sorted(self.forks.values(), key=lambda f: f[-1].block_hash)
614	            ]
615	        # Sync metadata is persisted in the same atomic document as the
616	        # candidate chains it references.
617	        if self.syncs:
618	            data["syncs"] = [
619	                {
620	                    "source": key[0],
621	                    "request_id": key[1],
622	                    "tip_hash": rec["tip_hash"],
623	                    "expires_at": rec["expires_at"],
624	                    "fingerprint": rec["fingerprint"],
625	                }
626	                for key, rec in sorted(self.syncs.items())
627	            ]
628	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(self.path)) or "."
629	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
630	        # Hold the class-wide recovery lock while a .ledger-* snapshot exists
631	        # on disk, so a concurrent in-process LedgerStore construction cannot
632	        # scan a half-written promotion.
633	        with self._recovery_lock:
634	            fd, tmp_path = tempfile.mkstemp(
635	                prefix=SNAPSHOT_PREFIX,
636	                suffix=f".gen{next_generation}",
637	                dir=directory,
638	            )
639	            promoted = False
640	            try:
641	                with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
642	                    json.dump(data, fh, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
643	                    fh.flush()
644	                    os.fsync(fh.fileno())
645	                os.replace(tmp_path, self.path)
646	                promoted = True
647	                self._fsync_dir(directory)
648	                self.generation = next_generation
649	            finally:
650	                if not promoted and os.path.exists(tmp_path):
651	                    # Promotion never happened: drop the half-written candidate so
652	                    # it cannot masquerade as a recoverable snapshot. A candidate
653	                    # written and fsynced *before* a crash during replace survives
654	                    # precisely because that crash skips this cleanup.
655	                    try:
656	                        os.unlink(tmp_path)
657	                    except OSError:
658	                        pass
659	
660	    @staticmethod
661	    def _fsync_dir(directory: str) -> None:
662	        """Best-effort directory fsync so a rename survives a power loss."""
663	        try:
664	            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
665	        except OSError:
666	            return
667	        try:
668	            os.fsync(dir_fd)
669	        except OSError:
670	            pass
671	        finally:
672	            os.close(dir_fd)

674	    # -- chain helpers --------------------------------------------------------
675	
676	    def tip(self) -> Block:
677	        return self.chain[-1]
678	
679	    def tip_hash(self) -> str:
680	        return self.chain[-1].block_hash
681	
682	    def next_height(self) -> int:
683	        return self.chain[-1].height + 1
684	
685	    def tip_is_pending(self) -> bool:
686	        return self.chain[-1].status == STATUS_PENDING
687	
688	    def block_at(self, height: int) -> Block | None:
689	        if 0 <= height < len(self.chain) and self.chain[height].height == height:
690	            return self.chain[height]
691	        return None
692	
693	    def rollback_tip(self) -> Block:
694	        """Remove the pending tip block and return its transactions to the mempool.
695	
696	        Transactions are restored de-duplicated: an id already present in the
697	        pending set (resubmitted while the block was unconfirmed) is kept as
698	        is, not overwritten. Caller must hold the lock and must have checked
699	        that the tip is a pending block. Does not save; callers persist.
700	        """
701	        block = self.chain.pop()
702	        for tx in block.transactions:
703	            self.pending.setdefault(tx.tx_id, tx)
704	        return block
705	
706	    # -- fork candidates ------------------------------------------------------
707	
708	    @staticmethod
709	    def _valid_tx_fields(tx: Transaction) -> None:
710	        """Structural checks shared by candidate submission and recovery."""
711	        if not isinstance(tx.sender, str) or not tx.sender:
712	            raise ValueError("transaction has an invalid 'from' field")
713	        if not isinstance(tx.recipient, str) or not tx.recipient:
714	            raise ValueError("transaction has an invalid 'to' field")
715	        if isinstance(tx.amount, bool) or not isinstance(tx.amount, int) or tx.amount <= 0:
716	            raise ValueError("transaction amount must be a positive integer")
717	        if not isinstance(tx.signature, str) or not tx.signature:
718	            raise ValueError("transaction is missing a signature")
719	
720	    def _parse_verified_chain(
721	        self, blocks_raw: object, endowment: int, genesis: Block | None = None
722	    ) -> list[Block]:
723	        """Strictly validate a block list submitted as (or persisted as) a fork.
724	
725	        The list must start from the canonical genesis block, connect through
726	        consecutive heights and prev_hash values, and carry recomputed-correct
727	        Merkle roots and block hashes. Transactions must have valid Ed25519
728	        signatures, ascending and globally unique tx_ids, and a replay from the
729	        per-identity endowment must never overspend. All blocks must be
730	        confirmed except an optional pending tip. Raises ValueError on any
731	        defect.
732	        """
733	        if not isinstance(blocks_raw, list) or not blocks_raw:
734	            raise ValueError("'blocks' must be a non-empty list")
735	        genesis = genesis if genesis is not None else self.chain[0]
736	        blocks: list[Block] = []
737	        seen_tx_ids: set[str] = set()
738	        for i, block_raw in enumerate(blocks_raw):
739	            if not isinstance(block_raw, dict):
740	                raise ValueError(f"block at position {i} is not a JSON object")
741	            try:
742	                block = Block.from_dict(block_raw)
743	            except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
744	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} is malformed: {exc}") from exc
745	            if isinstance(block.height, bool) or block.height != i:
746	                raise ValueError(
747	                    f"block at position {i} has non-consecutive height {block.height}"
748	                )
749	            expected_prev = GENESIS_PREV_HASH if i == 0 else blocks[i - 1].block_hash
750	            if block.prev_hash != expected_prev:
751	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has a mismatched prev_hash")
752	            if block.status not in (STATUS_PENDING, STATUS_CONFIRMED):
753	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} has unknown status {block.status!r}")
754	            if i == 0:
755	                # The candidate must connect to *the* canonical genesis.
756	                if (
757	                    block.status != STATUS_CONFIRMED
758	                    or block.transactions
759	                    or block.block_hash != genesis.block_hash
760	                    or block.merkle_root != genesis.merkle_root
761	                ):
762	                    raise ValueError("first block must be the canonical genesis block")
763	            elif i < len(blocks_raw) - 1 and block.status == STATUS_PENDING:
764	                raise ValueError(f"pending block {i} is not the chain tip")
765	
766	            txs_raw = block_raw.get("transactions")
767	            if not isinstance(txs_raw, list):
768	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions must be a list")
769	            tx_ids: list[str] = []
770	            for j, tx in enumerate(block.transactions):
771	                self._valid_tx_fields(tx)
772	                if not crypto.verify_signature(tx.sender, tx.message, tx.signature):
773	                    raise ValueError(f"block {i} transaction {j} has an invalid signature")
774	                stored_id = txs_raw[j].get("tx_id") if isinstance(txs_raw[j], dict) else None
775	                if stored_id != tx.tx_id:
776	                    raise ValueError(
777	                        f"block {i} transaction {j} has a mismatched tx_id"
778	                    )
779	                if tx.tx_id in seen_tx_ids:
780	                    raise ValueError(f"duplicate transaction {tx.tx_id} in candidate")
781	                seen_tx_ids.add(tx.tx_id)
782	                tx_ids.append(tx.tx_id)
783	            if tx_ids != sorted(tx_ids):
784	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} transactions are not tx_id sorted")
785	            if crypto.merkle_root(tx_ids) != block.merkle_root:
786	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} Merkle root mismatch")
787	            if (
788	                compute_block_hash(block.height, block.prev_hash, block.merkle_root)
789	                != block.block_hash
790	            ):
791	                raise ValueError(f"block {i} block_hash mismatch")
792	            blocks.append(block)
793	
794	        # Replay every transaction from the per-identity endowment; unconfirmed
795	        # (pending tip) transactions are included so a candidate can never hide
796	        # an overspend behind a pending final block.
797	        balances: dict[str, int] = {}
798	        for block in blocks:
799	            for tx in block.transactions:
800	                sender_balance = balances.get(tx.sender, endowment)
801	                if sender_balance < tx.amount:
802	                    raise ValueError(
803	                        f"replay overspend by {tx.sender} in block {block.height}"
804	                    )
805	                balances[tx.sender] = sender_balance - tx.amount
806	                balances[tx.recipient] = balances.get(tx.recipient, endowment) + tx.amount
807	        return blocks
808	
809	    def validate_fork_blocks(self, blocks_raw: object) -> list[Block]:
810	        """Validate and parse a candidate fork submitted by a client.
811	
812	        The blocks must start from the canonical genesis block, connect via
813	        consecutive heights and prev_hash, carry correct block hashes and
814	        Merkle roots, unique ascending tx_ids with valid Ed25519 signatures and
815	        no replay overspend, and be all confirmed except an optional pending
816	        tip. Raises ValueError with a descriptive reason on any defect.
817	        """
818	        endowment = (
819	            self.initial_balance if self.initial_balance is not None else 1_000_000
820	        )
821	        return self._parse_verified_chain(blocks_raw, endowment)
822	
823	    def _parse_persisted_forks(
824	        self, forks_raw: object, canonical_chain: list[Block]
825	    ) -> dict[str, list[Block]]:
826	        """Parse persisted candidate forks, dropping invalid ones on restart.
827	
828	        Every stored fork is re-validated exactly like a fresh submission
829	        (genesis connection, hashes, Merkle roots, signatures, uniqueness,
830	        replay). A fork that no longer validates is silently discarded rather
831	        than failing recovery of the canonical chain. Recovery of the canonical
832	        chain itself remains strict and still raises StateRecoveryError.
833	        """
834	        if not isinstance(forks_raw, list):
835	            return {}
836	        endowment = self.initial_balance if self.initial_balance is not None else 1_000_000
837	        genesis = canonical_chain[0]
838	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]] = {}
839	        for entry in forks_raw:
840	            try:
841	                fork = self._parse_verified_chain(entry, endowment, genesis)
842	            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
843	                continue
844	            if not fork or fork[0].block_hash != genesis.block_hash:
845	                continue
846	            tip_hash = fork[-1].block_hash
847	            # The canonical chain (or a strict prefix of it, matched by any
848	            # canonical block hash) is never also stored as a candidate.
849	            if any(tip_hash == block.block_hash for block in canonical_chain):
850	                continue
851	            forks.setdefault(tip_hash, fork)
852	        return forks
853	
854	    def replace_chain(self, new_chain: list[Block]) -> None:
855	        """Atomically adopt a fork: swap the canonical chain, reconcile the
856	        mempool (old-chain-only confirmed transactions return de-duplicated;
857	        pending-block transactions never enter the pool) and rebuild indexes.
858	        Does not save; the caller persists.
859	        """
860	        old_confirmed_ids = {
861	            tx.tx_id
862	            for block in self.chain
863	            if block.status == STATUS_CONFIRMED
864	            for tx in block.transactions
865	        }
866	        new_ids = {tx.tx_id for block in new_chain for tx in block.transactions}
867	        old_tx_by_id = {
868	            tx.tx_id: tx
869	            for block in self.chain
870	            for tx in block.transactions
871	        }
872	        # Transactions unique to the superseded chain's confirmed history go
873	        # back to the mempool, de-duplicated against anything already queued.
874	        # Transactions from the old pending tip are not in old_confirmed_ids,
875	        # so they are dropped, never re-enqueued.
876	        for tx_id in old_confirmed_ids - new_ids:
877	            self.pending.setdefault(tx_id, old_tx_by_id[tx_id])
878	        # Transactions now on the adopted chain must leave the mempool.
879	        for tx_id in new_ids:
880	            self.pending.pop(tx_id, None)
881	        self.chain = new_chain
882	        self.rebuild_derived()
883	
884	    # -- sync records ---------------------------------------------------------
885	
886	    def prune_syncs(
887	        self, now: float | None = None
888	    ) -> tuple[list[str], dict[tuple[str, str], dict]]:
889	        """Drop expired sync records in memory.
890	
891	        A record expires once ``expires_at`` has passed. Returns the orphaned
892	        tip hashes together with every removed record (keyed by
893	        ``(source, request_id)``) so the caller can persist the sweep
894	        atomically and restore the pre-cleanup state if that write fails.
895	        Tips adopted onto the canonical chain are not present in ``forks`` and
896	        are simply skipped when the caller reconciles them. Does not save; the
897	        caller persists.
898	        """
899	        current = time.time() if now is None else now
900	        expired_tips: list[str] = []
901	        removed: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
902	        for key in list(self.syncs):
903	            rec = self.syncs[key]
904	            if rec["expires_at"] <= current:
905	                expired_tips.append(rec["tip_hash"])
906	                removed[key] = rec
907	                del self.syncs[key]
908	        return expired_tips, removed
909	
910	    def restore_syncs(
911	        self,
912	        removed: dict[tuple[str, str], dict],
913	        forks: dict[str, list[Block]],
914	    ) -> None:
915	        """Restore sync records and candidate forks removed by a failed sweep.
916	
917	        Only records still missing are re-inserted, and the matching candidate
918	        forks are put back only when no other live record still references the
919	        tip. Caller must hold the lock.
920	        """
921	        for key, rec in removed.items():
922	            self.syncs.setdefault(key, rec)
923	        for tip, fork in forks.items():
924	            self.forks.setdefault(tip, fork)
